title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Maya Patel
description: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, multiple tool-calling example quickstarts (Python + TypeScript), and the corresponding docs site pages and navigation updates. Motivation: provide first-party, production-oriented examples for integrating Redwood agents with external tools (search, DB, ticketing) and to accelerate internal and external onboarding for customers building RAG agents. Changes include new example repos under /examples/agents/rag, three quickstart walkthroughs with runnable code and Docker compose for local testing, docs site pages describing recommended prompt templates and eval patterns, and a small update to the docs side navigation and quickstarts index. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates (query + chunking + relevance filtering) - [x] Tool-calling examples: search connector, vector DB upsert/query, and a ticketing webhook example - [x] Quickstarts: python/ts/console with step-by-step run instructions and expected outputs - [x] Docs site pages and sidebar updates - [x] CI/linting passing, small e2e smoke tests for examples - [x] Add LICENSE/README for examples and usage notes Notes: kept examples lightweight (uses SQLite + local vector store or a dockerized Milvus dev image optional) to avoid infra friction; included clear instructions on swapping to managed vector DBs and production considerations (batching, caching, prompt templates, safety). Related work: references ENG-9211 for agent SDK ergonomics and DOC-437 for docs taxonomy. This is a docs-first PR: code in examples is intended to be copy-paste runnable and paired with the docs narrative. Post-merge follow-ups: add CI job to run quickstart smoke tests in ephemeral infra (tracked in ENG-9340).
